svg.title: Checkout lifecycle
svg.desc: On each checkout page. idle: the shopper fills the form; checkout.started comes once per checkout, when the cart has lines. On a multi-step form, a step whose checks fail sends checkout.invalid; one that passes sends checkout.continued and loads the next step page. A submit, or an express button, moves to placing: the cart is frozen, the form, the cart and the card are checked, then checkout.submitted is sent and the order is created. A check that fails (checkout.invalid), an order not created (sdk.error, checkout.failed) or a declined card (payment.failed) go back to idle. A created order (order.created) is placed and the page redirects: paid at once (order.paid, checkout.completed), to the next page, which loads the order; else (payment.redirected) to the gateway. A checkout page loaded after an unpaid return from the gateway sends payment.failed.

rect.style: fill: none; stroke: var(--clean-fg-muted, #6b7280); stroke-width: 1.2; stroke-dasharray: 4 3
